correctness.rationale: Jordan-totient incidence decomposition yields positive Schur complement Delta; H_e(d,y) has a proved prime-by-prime expression giving integral A^-1 L columns. Exact verifier passed 1,062 complete matrix cases and 4,512 bottom-row identities; finite tests do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The least denominator of the rational GCD–LCM quotient is a natural quantitative divisibility invariant, and the result handles every power and arbitrary coatom deletion pattern. Outside the two-prime, two-coatom chain exception the expression is independent of unselected prime support; the \(p^e+1\) single-deletion obstruction for any repeated prime gives a structural infinite-family answer stronger than a yes/no test. No general arbitrary-set theorem is claimed.
